jobs.description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer  From CAD Clean-up to Next-Generation Boat Design
jobs.description: Mechanical Engineer“Make X Shore’s CAD data something production can build from without guessing. Audit and rebuild assemblies, align them with the factory floor, and then help design the next-generation boat.”About the RoleX Shore’s existing CAD models and assemblies don’t fully reflect what’s actually being built on the factory floor — data has drifted from production reality, making it hard to trust drawings, plan rework, or hand off clean information to manufacturing. We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to audit and rebuild that CAD data, get it aligned with how boats are actually produced, and then move on to design work on X Shore’s next-generation boat platform.This is a hands-on role in two phases. First, you’ll dig into existing CAD, correct what’s out of sync with production, and work closely with the shop floor to close the gap between design intent and built reality. Once that foundation is solid, you’ll shift into forward-looking platform design for future boats. You’ll report to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager and be based on-site in Nyköping.Key Responsibilities    Audit existing CAD models and assemblies for accuracy, completeness, and structure    Rebuild or correct CAD data that no longer reflects what’s actually being built in production    Align CAD assemblies and drawings with current production reality, working directly with the shop floor    Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and manufactured parts    Maintain clean, well-structured CAD/PDM practices going forward    Support production with drawings, tolerances, and design clarifications during rework and manufacturing    Once alignment work is complete, contribute to the design and detailing of X Shore’s next-generation boat platform    Collaborate with electrical, production, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure designs are manufacturableRequired Qualifications    Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience    3-5+ years of experience in mechanical design, ideally in a manufacturing environment    Expert-level SOLIDWORKS proficiency — this is a must-have, including assemblies, drawings, and PDM    Demonstrated experience auditing, cleaning up, or rebuilding CAD data and assemblies    Comfortable working directly with production to resolve build discrepancies    Fluent in English; Swedish is a plus    Ability to work on-site in NyköpingDesirable Qualifications    Experience with composites and/or metals typical of marine or automotive manufacturing    Background in boat building, automotive, or another complex hardware environment    Familiarity with GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis    Experience contributing to a new product platform from early concept through releasePersonal QualitiesDetail-oriented and methodical, comfortable untangling messy legacy data without losing momentum. Equally at home on the shop floor verifying fit as at a CAD workstation. Takes ownership, follows through, and communicates clearly across engineering and production.Success Metrics (First 12 Months)    CAD data and assemblies for existing boats are audited, corrected, and aligned with what’s built in production    Production has accurate, trustworthy drawings and models to work from    Discrepancies between design and manufactured parts are identified and resolved    Meaningful contribution made to next-generation boat platform designLocation & StructureOn-site at X Shore Factory & HQ, Nyköping. Reports to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager.

jobs.occupation: Head chef to Mr.Bronck & Sallys at Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description: Stockholm outside, a world of guests inside, and a kitchen ready for your ideas. It´s time to bring your flavour to Sheraton Stockholm.  Sheraton Stockholm has been bringing people together in the heart of the city since 1971. Today, we’re shaping our next chapter, with a major transformation, fresh energy and new places to eat, drink and connect. With Archer Hotel Management as our operator and Marriott International as our brand family, we combine an international outlook with a strong sense of place. Now we’re looking for a Head Chef to lead the food experience at Mr. Bronck, Sally’s and our room service operation. Someone with a clear culinary point of view, a head for business and the ability to build a team people want to be part of.  From dinner at Mr. Bronck to food that complements a cocktail at Sally’s or a great meal delivered upstairs, you’ll make sure every experience feels considered, consistent and right for the setting. You’ll lead the daily a la carte kitchen operation and develop seasonal menus that give each concept its own character. Taste, presentation and timing matter equally, and you know how to deliver all three when service picks up. Behind every great service is a well-run kitchen You’ll take ownership of menu costing, purchasing, stock control and staffing, keeping quality high and food waste low. You’ll turn business forecasts into smart schedules, maintain strong food safety and HACCP routines, and keep a close eye on the financial performance of the operation. Just as importantly, you’ll recruit, coach and develop your team. You set clear expectations, share your knowledge and stay approachable under pressure. Working closely with colleagues across the hotel, you’ll help create a seamless experience for our guests. A creative chef and a grounded leaderYou bring at least five years of experience in a similar leadership role in a quality restaurant or hotel kitchen. You’re confident developing menus, leading busy services and balancing culinary ambition with commercial results. You care about the details and understand how your decisions affect the whole operation. You bring structure, curiosity and high professional standards, and you enjoy finding practical solutions when plans change. Your team can count on you for direction, support and a steady presence during a demanding service. You communicate confidently in English; Swedish is a plus. An established network within the industry is also welcome. Make your mark on our next chapterThis is an opportunity to influence the food, develop your team and help shape the next chapter of an iconic Stockholm hotel. You’ll join an international, inclusive workplace with opportunities to grow within Sheraton and the wider Marriott family, alongside access to employee hotel rates around the world. We offer a permanent, full-time position with a six-month probationary period and terms covered by a collective bargaining agreement.Are you ready to bring your ideas to the table?Send us your application. We review applications and meet candidates throughout the recruitment process, so the position may be filled before the closing date. Let’s create something worth coming back for.

Mat4Green Tech AB (M4GT) is a Chalmers University spin-out based in Gothenburg. We develop and commercialise closed-loop processes for recovering and refining metals from industrial materials, with our own lab and pilot facilities in Gothenburg. We are now looking for a chemist who will take hands-on ownership of our recycling and purification work.About the roleYou will run and develop hydrometallurgical and electrochemical processes in our lab and pilot facility, from leaching and solvent extraction to electrolysis and final purification. You plan, build and manage your own projects: you define what equipment and materials are needed, find and negotiate with suppliers, carry purchases through, and keep the work documented and safe. The Plant Coordinator supports the coordination and management of plant, vehicles, tools, and assets across operations in Sweden. The role supports asset management activities, lifecycle planning, and operational asset performance. The role supports plant availability, maintenance coordination, and efficient utilisation of company assets. The role works with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and service providers to support asset management, regulatory compliance, and commercial objectives.How this role lives our values This role supports the effective management of plant and assets by helping ensure that equipment, vehicles, and resources are available, maintained, and correctly managed throughout their lifecycle. By maintaining visibility of asset performance, availability, and compliance requirements, the role supports efficient operations and informed decision-making. Safety: Support a safe working environment by helping ensure assets, vehicles, equipment, and inspection requirements are managed in accordance with company and regulatory standards. Integrity: Support accuracy, accountability, and compliance through effective record management, asset tracking, and adherence to established processes. Teamwork: Build strong working relationships that support collaboration, communication, and coordinated asset management activities. Ownership: Take responsibility for following through on actions, resolving operational issues, and supporting the effective management of company assets. Sustainability: Support long-term value creation through responsible asset management, efficient utilisation, and sustainable lifecycle practices. Key ResponsibilitiesPlant & Asset Lifecycle Management:     Coordinate plant, vehicle, tool, and asset activities throughout the asset lifecycle, including receipt, return, allocation, and disposal in line with project requirements.     Support asset management strategies and asset replacement or upgrade planning. Maintenance & Compliance Coordination:     Coordinate planned and unplanned maintenance activities, inspections, testing requirements, and equipment compliance activities.     Maintain up-to-date asset records, tracking information, and compliance documentation, including leased and hired assets. Asset Operations & Procurement Support:     Coordinate plant movements, operational requirements, procurement activities, and supplier engagement.     Support commercial decision-making relating to plant acquisition, hire, utilisation, and cost management.     Support the procurement of fuel, spare parts, and other plant-related requirements. Sustainability & Asset Optimisation:     Support effective asset utilisation, reuse, sale, recycling, and sustainability initiatives in line with the company’s sustainability strategy. Fleet & Incident Coordination:     Coordinate fleet-related incidents, repairs, and recovery activities.    Coordinate vehicle maintenance requirements in line with applicable regional requirements. Health, Safety & Regulatory Compliance:     Support compliance with safety, environmental, sustainability, regulatory, and internal company requirements. Commercial Administration:     Support the effective management of plant and asset-related costs.     Reconcile monthly invoices and account statements relating to plant and assets. Key Requirements     3rd level qualification or equivalent experience in procurement, purchasing, commercial functions, or construction plant operations.     Experience in a similar position (typically 3 years or more).     Knowledge of plant and asset management.     Knowledge of Swedish regulatory requirements and construction industry standards.     Experience using asset management systems and tools.     Analytical skills, process awareness, and attention to detail.     Communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.     Fluent English; Swedish language skills are advantageous.     Valid Swedish or EEA driver's licence.Skills     Plant and asset management knowledge.     Regulatory compliance knowledge.     Asset management systems knowledge.     Analytical and process management skills.     Stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.     Commercial awareness. TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.Would you like to build digital products and services that connect vehicles, customers and the people who keep vehicles on the road?TECHLA is looking for experienced full-stack developers for assignments in automotive and connected services. You’ll work in product teams developing everything from customer-facing applications to cloud-based services and integrations.The technology stack varies by assignment. It may include React and TypeScript on the frontend, with backend services built using Java and Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Node.js, Python or Go. Teams work with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.What you’ll work onDepending on the assignment, you may:    Design, build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript    Develop backend services, APIs and integrations    Connect user-facing applications to cloud services and distributed systems    Work with microservices and event-driven architectures    Build and operate solutions on AWS or Azure    Develop automated tests and improve CI/CD, monitoring and service reliability    Contribute to technical design, code reviews and architecture discussions    Take features from requirements and design through implementation, testing and productionWhat we’re looking for    Several years of professional full-stack development experience, typically five or more    Hands-on experience developing both frontend and backend functionality    Strong frontend skills in React and TypeScript, or comparable modern web technologies    Strong backend experience in at least one relevant stack, such as Java/Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Node.js, Python or Go    Experience building APIs, integrations or distributed applications    Experience with AWS and/or Azure    A good understanding of testing, code quality and maintainable software    The ability to collaborate with colleagues across product, design and engineering    Fluent English; Swedish is a plus.    A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.It’s a plus if you have    GraphQL, Kafka or other event-streaming technologies    AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS    Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD    SQL and NoSQL databases    Experience from automotive, connected vehicles, telecom or other product-focused environments    Experience operating and improving production servicesThe mindset we’re looking forFor us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.
